findings.problem: Target flag trusts completed/order metadata and observed-key union. Missing blocks, repetitions or request kinds are not compared to configuration/manifest; duplicate records silently overwrite earlier records at line 24. Actual engine rotation is not audited; absent order balance defaults True.
findings.required_fix: Derive exact expected blocks and request inventory from frozen configuration, selected manifest sessions, split and planned repetitions. Reject duplicates, omissions, unexpected blocks/records, mutated cases/requests, failed/interrupted blocks, missing metric coverage and actual order mismatch. Require verified complete balanced positions and complete warmup protocol before target can pass. Retain diagnostic partial summaries with target false.
findings.resolution: service_inventory.audit reconstructs exact engine/repetition rotation, all selected session/kind records and their sequence, warmups and request payloads from frozen config+manifest. Duplicates, omissions, extras, invalid metrics, failed processes or missing source proof disable target. summarize uses that valid audit. Original incomplete-block fixture now cannot pass; tests retain only explicitly labeled fabricated software-test data.

findings.problem: Preparation commands point at the live workspace. Runner checks runtime/harness sources once before all blocks and records no per-block/final drift evidence. Helper sources public_service_report.py/prompt_token_audit.py and installed competitor code are not in the current harness hash list. Mid-run edits can produce mixed measured sources while the report remains completed.
findings.required_fix: Prepare from a dedicated frozen complete service runtime/harness/manifest extraction with a separate explicit interpreter path, hash all imported helper code, record competitor environment/source provenance, and verify source state before/after every block and final summary; drift must disable target. Update executable docs commands accordingly.
findings.resolution: prepare freezes all 72 runtime/experiment/helper/manifest/lock files into a dedicated extraction and deterministic archive, while interpreter path is separate. check binds runner/helper/runtime import locations and service command/cwd/PYTHONPATH to extraction. Actual Python executable, package versions and 22,954 installed environment files are hashed. Initial, each block before/after, and final checks are recorded and required by inventory. Real CPU --verify-only independently returned verified=true.

findings.problem: Default documented report directory receives server .log files. Distribution verifier forbids .log files, and server tracebacks may contain private absolute home paths. Only raw JSON gets recursive aliases.
findings.required_fix: Keep complete server logs in excluded benchmarks/results/<run>; publish only safe relative audit references and hashes or a separately sanitized text excerpt.
findings.resolution: Complete logs/private raw now write only excluded benchmarks/results/private-service/<run>; public records contain PRIVATE_RESULTS alias, SHA256 and bytes. Recursive aliases now cover dictionary keys as well as values. Publicizing the actual prepared config removes home paths and preserves both environment digests. Frozen source archive inspected directly: no home paths, log files or model weights.

findings.problem: An existing regular directory at models/Qwen3.5-9B-8bit is accepted without resolving to the pinned snapshot. oMLX can then load different bytes from the native engine while declared identity metadata still matches.
findings.required_fix: Reject every preexisting alias unless it is a symlink resolving exactly to the audited snapshot; retain actual model file/hash audit for formal configuration.
findings.resolution: prepare refuses any existing alias unless it is a symlink resolving exactly to the audited pinned snapshot; wrong symlink and ordinary directory regression tests preserve unrelated user files. Per-block source checks also verify model alias has not changed.
